[i]As hostilities in the CapricornianJuane Strait escalated, the Jomslandic Coast Guard deployed assets to support Gendarmite naval operations against the advancing Bravanorian forces. With Juane Island at risk of a Bravanorian landing, Jomslandic patrol vessels and maritime reconnaissance aircraft provided crucial assistance in securing the maritime domain and ensuring the effectiveness of Gendarmite strikes.  
[b]Maritime Surveillance & Intelligence Support[/b] 
Operating from forward bases along the Jomslandic eastern seaboard, Coast Guard reconnaissance units relayed critical intelligence on Bravanorian naval movements to Gendarmite command. Utilizing advanced radar and electronic warfare suites, Jomslandic vessels assisted in tracking hostile fleet compositions and supply lines, allowing Gendarmes 1er and 3e Escadron du Ciel Jaune to optimize their missile strikes.  
[b]Naval Security & Anti-Interference Operations[/b]
In coordination with allied fleets, Jomslandic patrol ships maintained security in international waters, ensuring that no third-party actors could interfere with Gendarmes operations. Additionally, Jomslandic fast-attack craft patrolled the northern approaches to Juane Island, deterring potential Bravanorian submarine incursions that could threaten the strike mission.  
[b]Electronic Warfare & Decoy Assistance[/b]
Jomslandic electronic warfare specialists supported Gendarmes cruise missile attacks on Bravanorian command centers in Sebastio. By deploying electronic countermeasures and radar-reflective decoy drones, the Coast Guard helped disrupt Bravanorian surface-to-air missile tracking, increasing the likelihood of successful strikes against enemy infrastructure.  
The Jomslandic Coast Guards contributions reaffirm Jomslands commitment to its close partnership with Gendarme in maritime defense. As the conflict in the CapricornianJuane Strait unfolds, Jomslandic forces remain vigilant, prepared to support their allies against Bravanorian aggression.[/i][/spoiler]
